limitations: CSPconsoleAPIreturnedempty;earlierattemptretainedasnarrowfailureonly. Lateruntrustedloopbackreportcorrelatedwithnativeactionprovesexpectedrequestdenial,notauthenticatedbrowserattestation. No synthetic POST was sent to live endpoint.

The original recovery bundle is retained separately with an exact media descriptor; metadata-package evidence includes the independent binary review, not the MP3 payload. No generic recursive all-bodies-retained claim is made.

limits: Both complete hosted test families request Node 20.19.x in the exact-source workflows; the collector does not report the resolved patch runtime, so this is not a two-runtime matrix or a runtime-version observation.
The assembler itself executes no browser. Its separate pinned browser receipt records only the actual scoped frozen-preview and cold-offline observations; deployed public acceptance remains separate.
The exact-distribution browser evidence is pre-release scoped evidence only; it does not establish public v0.80.0 release or GitHub Pages acceptance.

No physical-hardware certification, complete controller/touch/screen-reader matrix, latency/memory benchmark, full-track listening approval, musical transition/loop-seam/mix approval, or Content ID clearance is claimed.
The zero-skip derivative fixture uses opaque OGG provenance bytes and a structurally inspected MP3 runtime; it does not decode OGG or prove a real audio conversion.

The frozen v0.80.0 payload admits metadata for 70 rights-audited hosted recordings, 15 collections and one pinned archive. It embeds none of their MP3 bytes in the distribution/core precache. Subjective listening approval remains pending; built-in original recordings and legacy optional soundtrack albums remain zero.

The 70 external MP3 objects and fifteen manual-import .rlsound packs remain externally hosted. AI-generated originals are paused/unadmitted; UA-FPV material remains private/unadmitted. No new rights or Content ID approval is granted by this package.
Tag creation, release publication, original uploads, and deployed acceptance remain separate operations.

The merge has ordered parents base then exact source, an identical source/merge tree, and an empty source-to-merge diff; the release payload remains bound to the exact qualified source commit and tree.
